column3: Close to the Hebrew.
“Complete heart” is rendered “whole heart.”
“Secure on him” is rendered “firmly in his grasp.”
“Parents” and “children” are rendered “fathers” and “sons”; NASB supplies “did.”
“Enrolled” is rendered “took a census of,” and “body shield” as “shield.”
Close to the Hebrew.
NASB supplies “nor with.”
The Hebrew is difficult; NASB renders it “But if you do go, do it … yet God will bring you down,” and the meaning is uncertain.
“What is to do” is rendered “what shall we do.”
“Separated” is rendered “dismissed,” and “to their place” as “home.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Split open” is rendered “dashed to pieces.”
“The sons of the troop” is rendered “the troops.”
“Defeating” is rendered “slaughtering,” and “made smoke” as “burned incense.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Cease for yourself” is rendered “Stop!”; NASB supplies “the king.”
“Let us look at one another faces” is rendered “let us face each other.”
“To a wife” is rendered “in marriage,” and “the animal of the field” as “a wild beast.”
“Your heart has lifted you to become heavy” is rendered “your heart has become proud in boasting.” “Engage in strife with harm” is rendered “provoke trouble.”
NASB supplies “of Joash.”
“Looked at one another faces” is rendered “faced each other.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Made a breach” is rendered “tore down.”
The Hebrew lacks a verb at the start; NASB supplies “he took.” “The sons of the pledges” is rendered “the hostages.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Matters” is rendered “acts.”
“From after Yahweh” is rendered “from following the LORD.”
“Carried” is rendered “brought.”
